recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless future generated JSON Schema output reintroduces rateSimpleQuantity; if that happens, fix the active schema-generation tooling rather than changing the MedicationAdministration, Dosage, or NutritionOrder definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-27842 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core MedicationAdministration, raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that the human-readable standard page listed MedicationAdministration.rateQuantity while JSON Schema outputs, including MedicationAdministration.schema.json, Dosage.schema.json, NutritionOrder.schema.json, and fhir.schema.json, showed rateSimpleQuantity.
initial_application: No source commit tagged with FHIR-27842 was found in the current checkout history. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-06-22 record the work group conclusion that rateSimpleQuantity was a tooling bug and moved the issue as a technical correction.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini, Dosage is an active datatype, and NutritionOrder is an active resource. Current core source keeps the affected elements as rate[x] choices with Quantity or SimpleQuantity typing where appropriate and contains no rateSimpleQuantity element. The current build.fhir.org fhir.schema.json.zip exposes MedicationAdministration_Dosage.rateQuantity, Dosage_DoseAndRate.rateQuantity, and NutritionOrder_Administration.rateQuantity, with zero rateSimpleQuantity hits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core source and current generated schema surface already satisfy the Jira request, so changing source definitions would be incorrect and unnecessary.
